title: Quadrature Decoder
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Sensor Decoders/Quadrature_Decoder.md
text: Compute position of quadrature encoder, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Position unit} sets Unit of angular position output; {Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)} enables CountsPerRev and 1/CountsPerRev input, {Data type for 1/CountsPerRev input} sets the data type of 1/CountsPerRev, {Encoder slits} sets the number of slits per phase, {Encoder counts per slit} sets the number of counts generated for every slit, {Counter size} sets the size of quadrature encoder counter, {External index count} enables Idx input port and {Position data type} sets the data type of angular position output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Quadrature encoder counter value at last index pulse scalar

ports.name: CountsPerRev
ports.summary: Number of counts generated for every revolution scalar

ports.name: 1/CountsPerRev
ports.summary: Inverse of the number of counts generated for every revolution scalar

ports.name: θ m
ports.summary: Angular position of quadrature encoder scalar

params.name: Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)
params.values: Enable CountsPerRev and 1/CountsPerRev input ports off (default) | on

params.name: Data type for 1/CountsPerRev input
params.values: Data type of 1/CountsPerRev input single (default) | double | fixed point

params.name: Encoder slits
params.values: Number of slits per phase 1000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Encoder counts per slit
params.values: Number of counts generated for every slit 4 (default) | 1 | 2

params.name: Counter size
params.values: Size of quadrature encoder counter 16 bits (default) | 8 bits | 32 bits

params.name: External index count
params.values: Enable Idx input port on (default) | off

params.name: Position unit
params.values: Unit of angular position output Radians (default) | Degrees | Per unit

params.name: Position data type
params.values: Data type of angular position output single (default) | double | fixed point
